Seven arrested in Kerala MDMA drug bust

Authorities in Thrissur, Kerala, have arrested seven individuals in connection with a significant drug bust. During the operation, 308 grams of MDMA, valued at approximately ₹15 lakh, were seized. One woman reportedly attempted to conceal the drugs in her private parts to avoid detection.
